Swerve Krakens Left Joystick.source:
test "Swerve Krakens Left Joystick"
device "frontLeft Drive Motor"
device "frontRight Drive Motor"
device "backLeft Drive Motor"
device "backRight Drive Motor"
device "controller0"

unsafe-exit "frontLeft Drive Motor".output_percent_cmd
unsafe-exit "frontRight Drive Motor".output_percent_cmd
unsafe-exit "backLeft Drive Motor".output_percent_cmd
unsafe-exit "backRight Drive Motor".output_percent_cmd

main:
    set "frontLeft Drive Motor".output_percent_cmd = controller0.leftY deadband 0.12 scaled 0.20 default 0.0
    set "frontRight Drive Motor".output_percent_cmd = controller0.leftY deadband 0.12 scaled 0.20 default 0.0
    set "backLeft Drive Motor".output_percent_cmd = controller0.leftY deadband 0.12 scaled 0.20 default 0.0
    set "backRight Drive Motor".output_percent_cmd = controller0.leftY deadband 0.12 scaled 0.20 default 0.0
    abort controller0.B

spark25_to_limit.source:
